No article numbers, clause text, or specific requirements are asserted here, because this session had no network access to verify current text against an authoritative source (e.g. 全國法規資料庫, law.moj.gov.tw) or against the referenced HJPLUS_Taiwan_Architect_KB repository. entries.title: 建築法 (Building Act)
entries.summary: Primary statute governing building permits, construction supervision, and use of buildings in Taiwan.

entries.title: 建築技術規則 (Building Technical Regulations)
entries.summary: Technical regulation set implementing the Building Act, split into sub-volumes covering general provisions, design/construction, structure, and equipment.

entries.title: 建築師法 (Architects Act)
entries.summary: Governs licensing, registration, and professional conduct requirements for architects practicing in Taiwan.

entries.title: 消防法 (Fire Services Act)
entries.summary: Governs fire safety equipment, inspection, and fire-prevention requirements for buildings.

entries.title: 無障礙建築物相關法規 (Accessible Building Regulations)
entries.summary: Cross-references accessibility design requirements for public buildings, drawn from the Building Technical Regulations and disability rights legislation.
tags: 身心障礙者權益保障法

entries.title: 都市計畫法 (Urban Planning Act)
entries.summary: Governs land use zoning and urban planning constraints relevant to building/construction projects.

entries.title: 政府採購法 (Government Procurement Act)
entries.summary: Governs the procurement process for public construction and architecture/engineering services contracts, administered by the Public Construction Commission (工程會).
